notes.title: 🛠 Astrum Vanguard – Demo v0.5.0 Update
notes.content:
[h1]🛠 [b]Astrum Vanguard – Demo v0.5.0 Update[/b][/h1][p]
Version 0.5.0 is now live!
This update not only introduces new weapons but fundamentally changes gameplay: with weapon classes, new enemies, and more tactical depth![/p][hr][/hr][h1]⚔️ [b]New Content[/b][/h1][h2]
[b]1. Weapons[/b][/h2][p]
[b]1a. Weapon Classes – Combine smart, dominate smarter![/b]
Weapons now belong to different classes.
Equipping multiple weapons of the same class grants you bonuses that can greatly influence your playstyle.[/p][p][b]Overview of weapon classes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Laser[/b] – Increases damage when combined[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plasma[/b] – Pierces multiple enemies but loses damage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Projectile[/b] – Increases attack speed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosion[/b] – Enlarges explosion radius[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drone[/b] – Increases evasion and armor[/p][/*][*][p][b]Experimental[/b] – Levels up faster[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ray[/b] – Extremely powerful, but weakens your ship (risk/reward)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]1b. New Starting Weapons[/b][/h2][p]
You now start each run with a random selection of weapons – making every run feel different![/p][p][b]1c. 10 New Weapons Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Small Ray[/b] – Basic level 1 ray weapon[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shield Drone[/b] – Intercepts enemy projectiles[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plasma Bolt[/b] – Large projectile that pierces through enemies[/p][/*][*][p][b]Laser Bolt[/b] – Large laser shot that explodes on impact[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dark Matter Bolt[/b] – Pierces some enemies and explodes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Havoc Missile Launcher[/b] – Fires a small spread of missiles[/p][/*][*][p][b]HE Railgun[/b] – Pierces one enemy and explodes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Piercing Laser[/b] – Pierces one enemy at reduced strength[/p][/*][*][p][b]Piercing Railgun[/b] – Pierces one enemy with lower damage[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]2. 🪐 New Boss: "Stellar Leecher"[/b][/h2][p]
A new boss awaits you in Wave 5!
The [i]Stellar Leecher[/i] attacks from long range, weakens your ship with ranged barrages, and brings new tactical challenges to the battlefield.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]⚙️ [b]Improvements & Optimizations[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Dynamic Screenshake:[/b]
The more damage you take relative to your max HP, the stronger the screenshake – for improved visual feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Red Damage Border:[/b]
A glowing red border now clearly indicates when you’ve taken damage.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]🎨 [b]Graphics Updates[/b][/h1][p]
Four new arena backgrounds – explore new galaxies, planets, and cosmic vistas![/p]

tags.feature: This update not only introduces new weapons but fundamentally changes gameplay: with weapon classes, new enemies, and more tactical depth!
Weapons now belong to different classes.
You now start each run with a random selection of weapons – making every run feel different!
10 New Weapons Added:
Small Ray – Basic level 1 ray weapon
Shield Drone – Intercepts enemy projectiles
Plasma Bolt – Large projectile that pierces through enemies
Laser Bolt – Large laser shot that explodes on impact
Dark Matter Bolt – Pierces some enemies and explodes
Havoc Missile Launcher – Fires a small spread of missiles
HE Railgun – Pierces one enemy and explodes
Piercing Laser – Pierces one enemy at reduced strength
Piercing Railgun – Pierces one enemy with lower damage
A new boss awaits you in Wave 5!
The Stellar Leecher attacks from long range, weakens your ship with ranged barrages, and brings new tactical challenges to the battlefield.
The more damage you take relative to your max HP, the stronger the screenshake – for improved visual feedback.
A glowing red border now clearly indicates when you’ve taken damage.
Four new arena backgrounds – explore new galaxies, planets, and cosmic vistas!

notes.title: Demo v0.3.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- Fixed a critical bug that caused the game to break when returning to the main menu during a wave.

- Reload time is now displayed correctly in the UI.

- Resolved an issue that prevented players from selecting the "Dodge" upgrade after leveling up.

- "Dodge" indicators no longer appear when flying through your own explosions.

- Fixed the ability of the Taibotian Cruiser to function as intended.

- Bosses no longer spawn directly on top of the player.

- Skill descriptions are now displayed correctly.

notes.title: ASTRUM VANGUARD – Demo v0.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Version 0.3.0 is out now![/b]

[h2]🆕 New Content[/h2]
[h3]New Enemies:[/h3]
[b]Brawler Bug [/b]– a durable melee unit that charges directly at you.
[b]Watcher Bug [/b]– a ranged attacker that fires precise energy beams.

[h3]New Boss:[/h3]
[b]The Overseer [/b]now appears in Wave 10.
Prepare for an intense showdown!

[h3]New Soundtrack:[/h3]
Added a new track: “[b]Floating[/b]” – setting the mood for deep-space battles.

[h3]New Ship Abilities:[/h3]
- Rebel-Ship
- Taibotian-Cruiser
Both ships now come equipped with [b]unique abilities[/b].


[h2]🔧 Improvements & Enhancements[/h2]
The [b]shop UI [/b]has been redesigned for better readability and usability.

[b]Mouseover tooltips [/b]added for attribute stats – making upgrades more transparent.

[b]Camera zoom[/b] has been adjusted – giving you a wider view of the battlefield.


[h2]🎨 Visual Updates[/h2]
Legacy enemy sprites have been reworked to better match the updated visual style.

notes.title: ASTRUM Vanguard V 0.2.7.3 DEMO – Patch Notes
notes.content:
ASTRUM Vanguard V 0.2.7.3 DEMO – Patch Notes

🆕 New Content:
- Demo extended: Now playable up to Wave 10!
- New Boss: Face a brand-new boss at Wave 10.
- Upgrade Tier 4: New Level-Up options added with Upgrade Level 4.

🔧 Improvements:
- Level-Up System: Some Player-Levels now provide predefined upgrades.

⚖️ Balancing:
- Target Prioritization: Improved how weapons select their targets.
- Weapon Balance: Adjusted stats for several weapons for better gameplay flow.

🐞 Bug Fixes:
- Weapon Unlocking: Locked weapons can now be unlocked in the shop even when carrying the maximum amount.
- Post-Wave Damage: You no longer take damage after a wave has ended.
- Stat Display Bug: Fixed an issue where some item/weapon stats were not shown correctly.
- Discord Link: The in-game link to our Discord now works properly.

Thanks for testing the demo and helping shape Astrum Vanguard! 💫

- New Boss: Face a brand-new boss at Wave 10.
- Upgrade Tier 4: New Level-Up options added with Upgrade Level 4.
- Level-Up System: Some Player-Levels now provide predefined upgrades.
